review: Every admitted image opened individually and full assembled targets reviewed. Source-served bytes preserved. Dates distinguish albums, later site photographs and pictured events.

title.en: Umayyads: governing from Damascus
title.zh: 倭马亚：以大马士革为中心统治

summary.en: The Umayyad dynasty moved the centre of caliphal power to Syria. From Damascus, its rulers governed a rapidly expanded realm stretching at its greatest reach from the Atlantic toward the Indus. Arabic gained an official administrative role, while artists and builders adapted Byzantine, Sasanian and local traditions to new settings. Monumental religious buildings expressed the dynasty’s authority in prominent urban spaces. Expansion did not create an immediately homogeneous society: languages, religions and local practices remained varied. The Abbasid revolution ended Umayyad rule in the east, while an Umayyad branch later ruled in Iberia.
summary.zh: 倭马亚将哈里发政治中心移至叙利亚，以大马士革为都城治理迅速扩张的疆域，最广时从大西洋延至印度河方向。阿拉伯语获得官方行政地位，艺术家则改造拜占庭、萨珊与地方传统。宏伟宗教建筑在城市中展示王朝权威。扩张并未立即制造同质社会，各种语言、宗教和生活方式仍然并存；阿拔斯革命后，倭马亚支系又在伊比利亚延续。

dateNote.en: 661–750 covers the Damascus caliphate; the later Iberian Umayyads have a separate chronology.
dateNote.zh: 661—750年指大马士革哈里发国；后来的伊比利亚倭马亚政权另有年表。

sources.title: The Art of the Umayyad Period (661–750)
sources.evidenceNote: 661–750 covers the Damascus caliphate; the later Iberian Umayyads have a separate chronology.

title.en: Córdoba: a caliphal capital
title.zh: 科尔多瓦：哈里发都城

summary.en: Córdoba was a major urban centre of al-Andalus. Its Great Mosque and surrounding historic fabric preserve layers of Roman, Islamic and later Christian building. During the caliphate, the city represented concentrated political and cultural resources. Its later changes show that buildings can survive by taking on new uses, while their meanings remain contested.
summary.zh: 科尔多瓦曾是安达卢斯的重要城市。大清真寺与周围历史街区保存了罗马、伊斯兰和后来基督教建筑的不同层次。在哈里发时期，城市汇聚了政治与文化资源。后来的改变也说明，建筑可因用途变化而延续，其意义却可能不断受到讨论。

dateNote.en: 929–1031 denotes the Caliphate of Córdoba, as listed by UNESCO. The city and mosque predate this period and continued afterward.
dateNote.zh: 929至1031年指联合国教科文组织列出的科尔多瓦哈里发时期。城市与清真寺在此之前已存在，此后也继续延续。

title.en: 1861: the Kingdom of Italy is proclaimed
title.zh: 1861年：意大利王国宣布成立

location.label: Turin; first capital of the Kingdom of Italy

summary.en: The proclamation of the Kingdom of Italy placed much of the peninsula under Victor Emmanuel II of the House of Savoy. It followed wars, diplomacy, popular mobilization and Garibaldi's southern campaign, combining movements whose goals had not always agreed. Turin was the new kingdom's first capital. Venetia and Rome were not yet part of it: their incorporation followed in 1866 and 1870. The founding date therefore marks an important stage of unification, rather than the instant appearance of every later Italian border or a common political experience across all regions.
summary.zh: 意大利王国宣布成立后，半岛大部分地区由萨伏依王朝的维托里奥·埃马努埃莱二世统治。统一结合了战争、外交、民众动员与加里波第的南方远征，参与者的目标并不始终一致。新王国首都是都灵，威尼托与罗马此时尚未纳入，分别于1866和1870年加入。因此，1861年是统一的重要阶段，而不是此后所有意大利边界或各地共同政治经验瞬间形成的日期。

dateNote.en: The kingdom was proclaimed on 17 March 1861. Later territorial and capital changes are mentioned as context, not backdated to 1861.
dateNote.zh: 王国于1861年3月17日宣布成立。后来的领土与首都变化仅用于说明背景，不追溯到1861年。

en: Turin, not Rome, was the capital at the kingdom's foundation.
Venetia joined in 1866 and Rome in 1870, making unification a sequence rather than a single map change.
zh: 王国建立时首都是都灵，而非罗马。
威尼托于1866年、罗马于1870年并入，统一是一个连续过程。

sources.title: 17 March 1861: Victor Emmanuel II, first king of Italy
sources.publisher: Historical Archive of the Presidency of the Italian Republic
sources.evidenceNote: Proclamation in Turin and the subsequent territorial stages.

sources.title: Italy: summary of relations
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.evidenceNote: Formation of the Kingdom of Italy in 1861 from much of the peninsula.

title.en: Damascus: a new mosque in an ancient sacred landscape
title.zh: 大马士革：古老宗教景观中的新清真寺

location.label: Great Mosque of Damascus; representative Umayyad monument

summary.en: Under al-Walid I, the Umayyad capital gained a major congregational mosque on a site previously occupied by a Roman temple and a Christian church. The building joined the requirements of Islamic worship with the skills and visual traditions of the late antique Mediterranean. Its location within Damascus’s older street plan makes urban continuity visible even as political and religious institutions changed. The present complex has a longer history of alteration and repair, so surviving features cannot all be treated as unchanged evidence from the early eighth century.
summary.zh: 瓦利德一世时期，倭马亚都城在曾有罗马神庙和基督教堂的地点营建大型聚礼清真寺。建筑把伊斯兰礼拜需求与晚期古代地中海地区的工艺及视觉传统结合起来。它处于大马士革较早的街道规划中，使政治与宗教制度变化中的城市延续清晰可见。现存建筑群经历了更长的增改与修复，不能将其所有构件都视为8世纪早期原封不动的证据。

dateNote.en: 705–715 follows al-Walid I’s reign as the construction context; the Met identifies Damascus’s mosque with 706. The interval is not an assertion that all present structures date to these years.
dateNote.zh: 705—715年采用瓦利德一世在位期作为营建背景；大都会博物馆将大马士革清真寺关联于706年。此时段并不意味着全部现存建筑都建于这些年。

en: The site had Roman and Christian religious uses before the Umayyad mosque.
The building developed within a city whose street pattern retained earlier layers.
zh: 倭马亚清真寺之前，此地曾有罗马及基督教宗教用途。
建筑所在城市的街道格局保留了更早历史层次。

sources.title: The Art of the Umayyad Period (661–750)
sources.evidenceNote: Dates al-Walid’s reign and the Damascus project, and explains adaptation of earlier artistic and architectural traditions.

sources.title: Ancient City of Damascus
sources.evidenceNote: Identifies Roman temple/Christian basilica layers and the mosque’s place in the inherited urban plan.

previousSummary.en: Under al-Walid I, the Umayyad capital gained a major congregational mosque on a site previously occupied by a Roman temple and a Christian church. The building joined the requirements of Islamic worship with the skills and visual traditions of the late antique Mediterranean. Its location within Damascus’s older street plan makes urban continuity visible even as political and religious institutions changed. The mosque is therefore useful for studying adaptation, patronage and the organization of sacred space. The present complex has a longer history of alteration and repair, so surviving features cannot all be treated as unchanged evidence from the early eighth century.

title.en: Norman Sicily: shared skills in royal buildings
title.zh: 诺曼西西里：王室建筑中的技艺交流

location.label: Palermo, Sicily; representative center of a multi-site architectural group

summary.en: The Norman kingdom of Sicily supported buildings that brought Latin Christian, Byzantine and Islamic artistic languages into close contact. At Palermo and nearby religious centers, mosaics, architectural forms and decorative craftsmanship reveal a court able to draw on different communities and traditions. The Palatine Chapel is especially useful for studying how royal authority was expressed through this combination of skills. The surviving monuments belong to a particular twelfth-century political setting, not to an abstract culture without conflict. Architectural exchange demonstrates collaboration and adaptation, but does not by itself prove equal social status or uninterrupted religious tolerance for everyone living under Norman rule.
summary.zh: 诺曼西西里王国营建的建筑，使拉丁基督教、拜占庭和伊斯兰艺术语言密切接触。巴勒莫及附近宗教中心的镶嵌画、建筑形式和装饰工艺，显示王廷能够吸收不同社区与传统的技艺。宫廷礼拜堂尤其有助于研究王权如何通过这种结合得到表现。现存古迹属于特定的十二世纪政治环境，而不是一个没有冲突的抽象文化。建筑交流能够证明合作与改造，却不能仅凭自身就证明诺曼统治下所有居民拥有平等地位，或宗教宽容从未中断。

dateNote.en: 1130–1194 is UNESCO’s Norman-kingdom frame for the architectural group. Individual buildings have different construction and alteration dates. Palermo represents a group also including Cefalù and Monreale.
dateNote.zh: 1130—1194年是联合国教科文组织用于建筑群的诺曼王国时段。各建筑的建造和改建日期并不相同。巴勒莫代表还包括切法卢与蒙雷阿莱的建筑群。

sources.title: Arab-Norman Palermo and the Cathedral Churches of Cefalú and Monreale
sources.evidenceNote: Heritage assessment gives 1130–1194 and describes nine monuments and the interaction of architectural traditions.

sources.title: Italian Peninsula, 1000–1400 A.D.
sources.evidenceNote: Museum chronology connects Roger II and later Norman rulers with the Palatine Chapel, royal buildings and Monreale mosaics.

en: Royal buildings combined Latin Christian, Byzantine and Islamic visual traditions.
Shared craftsmanship does not alone establish social or religious equality.
zh: 王室建筑结合拉丁基督教、拜占庭和伊斯兰视觉传统。
共同工艺本身不足以证明社会或宗教平等。

title.en: Brazil: from independent empire to changing republics
title.zh: 巴西：从独立帝国到变化的共和国

location.label: Brasília; later federal capital, representative point

summary.en:
Brazil’s independence in 1822 produced an empire rather than a republic. A constituent assembly met the following year, and the 1824 constitution organized the monarchy’s political institutions. The republic proclaimed in 1889 created another constitutional sequence.

Later assemblies, interruptions and new constitutions changed how the state operated. Brasília’s inauguration in 1960 also moved the federal center away from Rio de Janeiro. This continuous country entry links independence, abolition, republican change and the new capital while keeping their dates distinct. Continuity of the country’s name is not evidence that its regime or citizenship remained constant.
summary.zh:
1822年巴西独立产生的是帝国，而不是共和国。次年制宪会议召开，1824年宪法组织君主制政治机构。1889年宣布共和国，又开启另一条宪制序列。

后来议会、中断与新宪法改变国家运作。1960年巴西利亚启用，也使联邦中心离开里约热内卢。本持续国家条目连接独立、废奴、共和更替和新首都，同时保留各自日期。国名连续并不证明政体或公民身份始终相同。

dateNote.en: 1822 begins independence, not republican government. The empire ended in 1889. 2026 is the atlas cutoff for an ongoing country. Brasília is only the later capital; the point does not project it into the nineteenth century.
dateNote.zh: 1822年标记独立，而非共和政府开始。帝国于1889年终结。2026年为仍存国家的地图截止点。巴西利亚只是后来的首都，点位不把它倒投到19世纪。

sources.title: History and Archives of the Chamber of Deputies
sources.evidenceNote: Official account of the imperial assembly, 1889 republican transition and successive parliamentary buildings.

sources.title: Project of a Constitution for the Empire of Brazil
sources.publisher: Chamber of Deputies Digital Library, Brazil
sources.evidenceNote: Archival item contextualizes 1822 independence and the 1823 constituent assembly.

en: Independence produced an empire, followed by a republic in 1889.
The later capital cannot stand for the country’s government location in every year.
zh: 独立产生帝国，1889年后为共和国。
后期首都不能代表每一年政府所在地。

title.en: Dejima: a controlled port of exchange
title.zh: 出岛：受管制的交流港口

summary.en:
The Dutch trading post moved from Hirado to Dejima in 1641. Its small artificial island concentrated commercial activity in a place where officials could monitor people, cargo and communication. The arrangement depended on interpreters, suppliers and other local workers, not only merchants and rulers.

Dejima connected restricted trade with the circulation of reports and knowledge. Chinese commerce also operated in Nagasaki, while other Japanese external relationships used different routes. The island was consequently one regulated connection, not the entire history of Japan’s relations with the world. The Dutch factory closed in 1859 as the treaty-port order changed. Later reconstruction makes parts of the historical setting visible, but the present site includes interpretation and restoration rather than an untouched enclave.
summary.zh:
1641年，荷兰商馆从平户迁到出岛。这个小型人工岛把商业活动集中在便于官员监督人员、货物和通信的场所。其运作不仅依靠商人与统治者，还需要通译、供货者和其他本地劳动者。

出岛将受限贸易同报告、知识的流通相连。中国商人也在长崎交易，而日本其他对外关系还使用不同路线。因此，出岛是受管制的一条联系，并非日本对外关系的全部。1859年，伴随通商口岸秩序改变，荷兰商馆关闭。后来的复原让部分历史环境重新可见，但今日遗址包括解释与重建，并非未经改变的旧商馆。

dateNote.en: 1641–1859 covers the Dutch factory at Dejima; the island was constructed earlier, in 1636.
dateNote.zh: 1641—1859年指荷兰商馆驻出岛时期；人工岛始建于1636年。

sources.title: Dejima History
sources.evidenceNote: 1603 shogunate; 1636 island; 1641 Dutch relocation; 1859 factory closure. European trade is not all Japanese foreign contact. Retrieval: page text inspected.

sources.title: The Edict of 1635 Ordering the Closing of Japan
sources.evidenceNote: Translated shogunal instructions for Nagasaki; prescriptive text, not proof of uniform enforcement. Retrieval: page text inspected.

sources.title: Art of the Edo Period (1615–1868)
sources.evidenceNote: Urban production, art and limited foreign trade; wording implying complete isolation is qualified. Retrieval: page text inspected.

en: Interpreters and suppliers sustained the trading post.
Dejima was one channel among several external relationships.
zh: 通译与供货者维持商馆运作。
出岛只是多种对外关系中的一条渠道。

title.en: Austria-Hungary: shared affairs and competing national claims
title.zh: 奥匈帝国：共同事务与竞争的民族诉求

location.label: Budapest; one of the dual monarchy’s governmental centers

summary.en:
The Compromise of 1867 reorganized Habsburg rule into an Austrian and a Hungarian half, each with its own government and parliament. The monarch and certain shared affairs connected them, while domestic policy followed different institutions. Vienna and Budapest therefore represent related centers of government rather than interchangeable capitals of a centralized nation-state.

The settlement privileged particular political elites without satisfying all the empire’s linguistic and national communities. Education, administration and public language could become matters of conflict as people sought rights and representation. The dual structure existed alongside economic and cultural connections that crossed its internal divisions. Its endpoint in 1918 belongs to the breakup of the monarchy at the end of the First World War. A political overview explains the constitutional arrangement; local histories are necessary to understand its unequal consequences for different populations.
summary.zh:
1867年的妥协把哈布斯堡统治重组为奥地利与匈牙利两部分，各有政府和议会。君主与若干共同事务把两部分联系起来，内政则由不同机构处理。因此，维也纳与布达佩斯是相互关联的政府中心，并非一个中央集权民族国家中可以互换的首都。

这一安排优待特定政治精英，却没有满足帝国内所有语言和民族群体。人们争取权利与代表权时，教育、行政和公共语言都可能成为冲突领域。二元结构同时伴随跨越内部分界的经济与文化联系。1918年的终点属于第一次世界大战结束时君主国的解体。政治总览能够解释宪制安排，而理解不同人群所承受的不平等后果，还需要地方历史。

dateNote.en: 1867–1918 denotes the dual constitutional arrangement; internal administration and territorial membership changed. No boundary geometry is supplied.
dateNote.zh: 1867—1918年指二元宪制安排；内部行政和领地构成曾变化。本条不提供边界几何。

title.en: Russian emancipation of 1861: freedom, land and obligations
title.zh: 1861年俄国农奴解放：自由、土地与义务

location.label: St Petersburg; representative literary and imperial administrative context

summary.en:
Alexander II’s 1861 reform changed the legal position of privately owned serfs in the Russian Empire. Freedom and access to land were related but different questions. Arrangements for allotments, compensation and continuing obligations meant that emancipation could not be understood simply as an immediate transfer of unrestricted property.

A U.S. diplomatic report written in 1865 describes payments, government loans and local variation, while strongly praising the emperor. It is useful evidence of how a foreign observer explained the reform, but its optimism should not be mistaken for the voices of all former serfs. This entry separates the legal turning point from the longer history of rural resources and dependency. Shevchenko’s earlier purchase of individual freedom provides a related personal story; it was not the same mechanism as the 1861 settlement.
summary.zh:
亚历山大二世1861年的改革改变了俄罗斯帝国私人领主所属农奴的法律地位。获得自由与取得土地是相互关联却不同的问题。份地、补偿和继续承担义务的安排，意味着农奴解放不能简单理解为立即获得不受限制的财产权。

1865年美国外交官的一份报告描述了付款、政府贷款与地方差异，同时高度赞扬皇帝。它有助于了解一名外国观察者如何解释改革，但其乐观态度不能代表所有获释农奴的声音。本条区分法律上的转折点与更长期的农村资源和依附关系。舍甫琴科此前通过赎身获得个人自由，提供了相关的个人故事，却并非1861年改革所采用的同一种机制。

dateNote.en: 1861 marks a legal reform; implementation and financial obligations continued afterward. Only the year is used to avoid mixing calendar conventions.
dateNote.zh: 1861年为法律改革节点，实施与经济义务延续其后。仅使用年份，以免混用历法。

sources.title: C. M. Clay to William H. Seward, 8 January 1865
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.evidenceNote: Primary diplomatic report describes the 1861 reform, local land arrangements, payments and continuing service. Its praise of the emperor is treated as the author’s perspective; its precise decree date and population estimates are not adopted.

sources.title: The Emancipation of the Russian Serfs, 1861
sources.evidenceNote: Accessible introductory text supports the 1861 reform under Alexander II and the distinction between serfdom and freedom. No claim to have read subscriber-only continuation; the introduction’s comparison with U.S. abolition is not used.

en: Legal freedom did not resolve every question of land access.
zh: 法律自由并未解决全部土地取得问题。

reviewLimit.en: The diplomatic report is explicitly situated and does not represent peasant testimony; no universal allotment size or outcome is claimed.
reviewLimit.zh: 明确外交报告的立场，不将其视为农民证词，也不声称份地大小或改革结果处处相同。

title.zh: 1862年的科尔多瓦大清真寺

alt.en: Rows of columns support two tiers of arches receding into the dim interior of Córdoba’s mosque-cathedral.

interpretation.en: The repeated columns and double-tier arches make the scale of the prayer hall visible. Clifford photographed the building centuries after its conversion to a cathedral, showing the continued presence of Islamic architecture within a changed religious setting.

title.zh: 1877年的大马士革大清真寺

alt.zh: 装裱在图册中的照片展现了长列庭院拱廊、带纹样的石砌墙面、塔楼，以及坐在拱券旁的人们。

caption.en: Félix Bonfils, colonnade of the Great Mosque at Damascus, 1877. Tinted albumen silver print; Getty 84.XO.1167.33.
caption.zh: 费利克斯·邦菲尔斯，大马士革大清真寺柱廊，1877年。着色蛋白银盐照片；盖蒂84.XO.1167.33。

interpretation.en: A major monument of the Umayyad capital appears here as a nineteenth-century place in use, with people resting along its arcades. The early mosque and its many later repairs belong to different stages of the building’s history; this photograph records its appearance in 1877.
interpretation.zh: 倭马亚都城的重要古迹，在这里是19世纪仍有人使用的空间，人们坐在拱廊旁休息。早期清真寺与多次后世修缮属于不同建筑阶段；这张照片记录的是1877年的面貌。

assets.creator: Félix Bonfils
assets.credit: J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles; 84.XO.1167.33

title.en: Carved columns at Monreale
title.zh: 蒙雷阿莱的雕饰立柱

alt.en: Paired columns with varied carved shafts and capitals support pointed arches around a cloister, in a photograph mounted on an inscribed sheet.
alt.zh: 成对立柱以不同纹样的柱身与柱头支撑回廊尖拱；照片装裱在带题字的纸页上。

caption.en: Giorgio Sommer, Monreale cloister, 1870–1890. Albumen silver print; Getty 91.XM.84.23.
caption.zh: 乔治奥·索默，蒙雷阿莱回廊，1870—1890年。蛋白银盐照片；盖蒂91.XM.84.23。

interpretation.en: The patterned shafts and carved capitals reveal the variety of stonecutting at Monreale. Part of the Norman Sicilian architectural group, the cloister survives here in a nineteenth-century photograph, with paired columns and pointed arches available for close inspection.
interpretation.zh: 带纹样的柱身与雕饰柱头，展现了蒙雷阿莱石雕工艺的多样性。回廊属于诺曼西西里建筑群；这幅19世纪照片保存了当时的面貌，可细看成对立柱与尖拱。

assets.creator: Giorgio Sommer
assets.credit: J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles; 91.XM.84.23

title.en: Garibaldi in an 1866 portrait album
title.zh: 1866年肖像图册中的加里波第

alt.en: An oval photograph shows a bearded Giuseppe Garibaldi with one hand at his hip, surrounded by the decorative lettering of an album portrait.
alt.zh: 椭圆形照片中的朱塞佩·加里波第留着胡须，一手叉腰，外围为肖像图册的装饰文字。

caption.en: Franck, portrait of Giuseppe Garibaldi in an album with text by Justin Lallier, dated 1866. Albumen silver print; Getty 84.XB.824.1.229.
caption.zh: 弗兰克摄，朱塞佩·加里波第肖像，见朱斯坦·拉利耶撰文、纪年1866年的图册。蛋白银盐照片；盖蒂84.XB.824.1.229。

interpretation.en: Garibaldi’s southern campaign was one of the different movements brought together in Italian unification. This small collectible portrait shows how his public image circulated after the kingdom’s proclamation in 1861. The catalogue’s 1866 date belongs to the album portrait, not to the campaign.
interpretation.zh: 加里波第的南方远征，是意大利统一过程中汇合的不同运动之一。这张小型收藏肖像展现了1861年王国宣布成立后，他的公众形象如何传播。目录中的1866年是图册肖像的年代，并非远征日期。

assets.creator: Franck (François-Marie-Louis-Alexandre Gobinet de Villecholles); album text by Justin Lallier
assets.credit: J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles; 84.XB.824.1.229

title.en: Alexander II in an 1866 portrait album
title.zh: 1866年肖像图册中的亚历山大二世

alt.en: Alexander II’s small military portrait sits below a crowned double-headed eagle and between colored leafy branches tied with a red ribbon.
alt.zh: 亚历山大二世的军装小肖像上方为戴冠双头鹰，两侧是以红丝带系起的彩色枝叶。

caption.en: Franck, portrait of Alexander II in an album with text by Justin Lallier, dated 1866. Albumen silver print with decorated surround; Getty 84.XB.824.1.19.
caption.zh: 弗兰克摄，亚历山大二世肖像，见朱斯坦·拉利耶撰文、纪年1866年的图册。蛋白银盐照片，配装饰边饰；盖蒂84.XB.824.1.19。

interpretation.en: The emperor associated with the 1861 emancipation appears in military dress beneath imperial arms. This presentation gives a concrete example of the ruler-centered public image that accompanied reform; the former serfs’ land, debts and experiences require the other evidence discussed in the entry.
interpretation.zh: 与1861年农奴解放相关的皇帝，以军装形象出现在帝国纹章下方。这一呈现方式具体展示了伴随改革的君主中心形象；原农奴的土地、债务与经历，则需结合条目讨论的其他证据理解。

assets.creator: Franck (François-Marie-Louis-Alexandre Gobinet de Villecholles); album text by Justin Lallier
assets.credit: J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles; 84.XB.824.1.19

title.en: Dejima after the Dutch factory closed
title.zh: 荷兰商馆关闭后的出岛

alt.en: A low waterfront lined with buildings projects into Nagasaki harbor, with sailing ships to the left and hills behind.
alt.zh: 低矮的建筑沿长崎港水边排列，左侧有帆船，后方是山地。

caption.en: Felice Beato, Decima at Nagasaki, 1863–1868. Albumen silver print; Getty 2007.26.70. The view postdates the Dutch factory’s closure in 1859.
caption.zh: 费利切·比阿托，《长崎出岛》，1863—1868年。蛋白银盐照片；盖蒂2007.26.70。照片摄于1859年荷兰商馆关闭之后。

interpretation.en: The low shoreline and closely packed buildings reveal the small physical scale of Dejima within the larger harbor. Beato recorded the site during the treaty-port era, soon after its earlier role as a confined Dutch trading post had ended.
interpretation.zh: 低矮岸线与密集建筑，展现了出岛在更大港湾中的有限尺度。比阿托在通商口岸时代记录此地，此时作为受限制荷兰商馆的旧职能刚结束不久。

assets.creator: Felice Beato
assets.credit: J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles; 2007.26.70

title.en: Franz Joseph before the dual monarchy
title.zh: 二元君主国成立前的弗朗茨·约瑟夫

alt.en: A small portrait of Franz Joseph in a light military uniform is framed by green branches and a crowned double-headed eagle.
alt.zh: 身着浅色军装的弗朗茨·约瑟夫小肖像，被绿色枝叶与戴冠双头鹰环绕。

caption.en: Franck, portrait of Franz Joseph I in an album with text by Justin Lallier, dated 1866. Albumen silver print with decorated surround; Getty 84.XB.824.1.3.
caption.zh: 弗兰克摄，弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世肖像，见朱斯坦·拉利耶撰文、纪年1866年的图册。蛋白银盐照片，配装饰边饰；盖蒂84.XB.824.1.3。

interpretation.en: The album is dated 1866, before the 1867 Compromise. Franz Joseph subsequently linked Austria and Hungary as emperor and king, while their governments and parliaments remained separate. The crown and double-headed eagle frame his portrait as an image of imperial authority.
interpretation.zh: 图册纪年1866年，早于1867年的妥协。此后，弗朗茨·约瑟夫以皇帝和国王的身份联系奥地利与匈牙利，两地仍分别保有政府和议会。王冠与双头鹰围绕肖像，呈现帝王权威。

assets.creator: Franck (François-Marie-Louis-Alexandre Gobinet de Villecholles); album text by Justin Lallier
assets.credit: J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles; 84.XB.824.1.3

title.en: Pedro II in imperial Brazil
title.zh: 巴西帝国时期的佩德罗二世

alt.en: A bearded Pedro II in a dark coat appears beneath the crowned green shield of imperial Brazil, surrounded by colored branches.
alt.zh: 身穿深色外套、留胡须的佩德罗二世肖像位于巴西帝国带冠绿色盾徽下方，四周有彩色枝叶。

caption.en: Franck, portrait of Pedro II of Brazil in an album with text by Justin Lallier, dated 1866. Albumen silver print with decorated surround; Getty 84.XB.824.1.7.
caption.zh: 弗兰克摄，巴西佩德罗二世肖像，见朱斯坦·拉利耶撰文、纪年1866年的图册。蛋白银盐照片，配装饰边饰；盖蒂84.XB.824.1.7。

interpretation.en: The crowned arms and named emperor make Brazil’s monarchical phase visible. This album, dated 1866, belongs within the independent empire, between the 1822 break with Portugal and the republic proclaimed in 1889.
interpretation.zh: 具名皇帝与带冠纹章，使巴西的君主制阶段清晰可见。图册纪年1866年，属于独立帝国时期，介于1822年脱离葡萄牙与1889年宣布共和之间。

assets.credit: J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles; 84.XB.824.1.7
